title: Patient Services Desk Guidance Note: The Review Visit for a Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Renewal
content:
The review visit for a renewal written order for the CGM supply allowance (HCPCS A4239) under the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program is taken from the clinical documents on the CGM program's medical records, and which practitioner's visit counts is fixed by the rule below. The review visit date is the visit date recorded on the clinical document so chosen.

**Rule.** The review-visit adjustment replaces the standard review visit by practitioner: when the program's treating prescriber has a visit on the program's medical records with purpose continued-need follow-up or initial qualification, the review visit is that prescriber's latest such visit; when the treating prescriber has none but the practitioner who signed the order has one, it is the signer's latest such visit; otherwise the standard review visit applies.

**Terms.**

- *Qualifying visit*: a clinical document on the CGM program's medical records whose recorded purpose is continued-need follow-up or initial qualification. A document recorded for any other purpose, such as an over-limit justification, is not a qualifying visit.
- *Treating prescriber*: the treating prescriber recorded on the CGM program, identified by NPI.
- *Signer of the order*: the practitioner whose NPI is on the renewal, the newest written order of the CGM supply allowance on the program.
- *Latest*: the qualifying visit with the latest visit date among those of the practitioner the rule looks at; follow-up visits and initial qualification visits are looked at together.

**Points of judgement.**

| Treating prescriber has a qualifying visit | Signer of the order has a qualifying visit | Review visit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | latest qualifying visit by the treating prescriber |
| no | yes | latest qualifying visit by the signer |
| no | no | the standard review visit |

Where the treating prescriber and the signer are the same practitioner, the first row governs whenever that practitioner has a qualifying visit.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** The program's medical records show a continued-need follow-up visit on 15 November of a hypothetical Year 0 by the treating prescriber, and an initial qualification visit on 3 February of Year 1 by another practitioner who also signed the renewal. The treating prescriber has a qualifying visit, so the review visit is 15 November of Year 0, although a later qualifying visit by another practitioner is on file. Had the treating prescriber no qualifying visit on file, the review visit would be the signer's visit of 3 February of Year 1. Had neither of them a qualifying visit on file, the standard review visit would apply.
